name: Peruvian Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Raico Morales, Giovana. 2024. Documentación y descripción de los valores distintivos de las configuraciones manuales en la lengua de señas peruana (LSP). MA thesis (Maestría en Lingüística), PUCP, Lima. 142 pp. Advisor M. Rodríguez Mondoñedo. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12404/28805
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about LSP stress/prominence. Sec. 2.1.1 (pp. 40-41) discusses 'acento' and 'entonación' only for Spanish as background ([oro]/[oró] minimal pair, Schwegler et al. 2010, Quilis 1997); sec. 2.1.2 (pp. 42-62) lists LSP parameters (configuración manual, punto de articulación, movimiento, espacio, rasgos no manuales) with no suprasegmental/prominence parameter; results chapter is on handshape minimal pairs from Lima signers.

sources.citation: Cerna Herrera, Francisco Antonio. 2023. Los pronombres personales de la lengua de señas peruana (LSP). Licentiate thesis, PUCP, Lima. 206 pp. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12404/25438
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No word-stress statement. Passing remarks only: demonstrative IX movement 'es usualmente más tenso y repetido' (attributed to Baker & Pfau 2016: 106, cross-linguistic, not LSP-specific); and 'Si en el español una pista de dicho cambio de contexto puede ser la entonación, en la LSP lo son las marcas no manuales' (discussion of example 87, role shift).

sources.citation: Ramos Cantu, César Augusto. 2022. Los verbos de concordancia doble de la lengua de señas peruana (LSP): un análisis del uso del espacio. Licentiate thesis, PUCP, Lima. 180 pp. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12404/24076
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on LSP stress. Wilbur 1999 'Stress in ASL' appears in the bibliography and is cited in the body only for the phonological marking of telicity (event visibility), not for stress.

sources.citation: Madrid Vega, Rodrigo Mauricio. 2018. Clasificadores en la lengua de señas peruana (LSP). Licentiate thesis, PUCP, Lima. 164 pp. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12404/12323 (Glottolog ref 578256)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing. a full-text search for stress/accent acento/prosod/prominen/stress/suprasegment/tensión/ritmo yields no LSP statement; the only 'énfasis' hit is a methodological note that signers emphasised non-manual features when judging recorded utterances (ch. on methodology).

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page peru1235 (references: Clark 2017 SLS; Parks & Parks 2015 SIL ESR 2015-007; Parks 2011 UND MA thesis; Campbell et al. 2022 ElCat) and Glottolog reference records 551368, 551379, 569683
sources.note: Bibliographic only; confirms that Glottolog holds no grammar or phonology for LSP - only sociolinguistic surveys, a wordlist-comparison thesis and the classifier thesis.
